note: Ramond-Elliott neurodevelopmental syndrome is linked to TRA2B variants characterized by neurodevelopmental delay and brain anomalies including thin or hypoplastic corpus callosum.

evidence.text: The founding cohort of Ramond-Elliott neurodevelopmental syndrome identified individuals with intellectual disability, developmental delay, and brain anomalies associated with TRA2B variants.

source.title: Clustered variants in the 5' coding region of TRA2B cause ...
source.quote: All affected individuals presented intellectual disability and/or developmental delay, frequently associated with infantile spasms, microcephaly, brain anomalies, autism spectrum disorder, feeding difficulties, and short stature.

evidence.text: OMIM clinical synopsis notes thin or hypoplastic corpus callosum among the recognized neuroimaging features of Ramond-Elliott neurodevelopmental syndrome.
